'''Shaythin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] under the command of [[Darth Gravus]] to help stop the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]]. Usually, Shaythin served as field commander of the Sith troops on the planet.
